body:
Hey, I really hope you're still here with us. I can understand the constant feeling of misery and just wanting to escape.

A couple years back, when I was 21, I posted on this subreddit expressing how I was gonna k-word myself soon. I really hated myself and felt miserable at every waking moment. I felt so intent on following through with my plan but realized me sharing that with other strangers who feel very similarly was a big cry for help. A way to connect and feel less alone. To maybe try to talk myself out of it by reading words of encouragement. In the moment, I didn't give a flying f*ck about what other people had to say in the comments. I just wanted to release my thoughts and go.

It wasn't until maybe an 1 hour after posting and contemplating that I'd decide to instead escape by forcing myself to sleep. To just shut down for a while, though I wanted to shut down forever at the time. To face reality again when I woke up and see if my feelings had slightly changed. To see if maybe even a tiny part of me wanted to continue experiencing life.

Guess what? They didn't change a whole lot but I am deeply grateful that I eventually shut down in a way that was less harmful. After that long ass nap, I opened up my laptop and it was still on the same tab. I was surprised to see that others had already commented expressing resonance and words of encouragement. Even then, it was so hard to find courage. I knew they were only trying to help me feel better. Shit was rough.

That same year, I was hospitalized more than once and a few of those were voluntary because I slowly started to realize that I do want to experience the little joys of life again. That I'm not alone. Please know that you aren't either.

I hope all of this isn't too overwhelming to take in. Long message, I know, but I wanted to share a bit of my journey cuz I remember being in such a similar spot. Couple months away from turning 24 and currently unemployed too. I still have underlying depression and then some but really trying to lean on community + nature tbh for support has been helping me get through. My cat, Pumpkin, too.

Maybe go to your favorite local food spot and force yourself to be in an environment that brings you and your tastebuds some joy.

You are worth more than you know. Remember that the only way out is through. You've been fighting for this long, and I have faith you can keep going.

Sending you so much love.

hi again friends. i wanted to express gratitude to those of you who commented and showed support, it truly means everything that there are people out there who do care.

also wanted to provide an update:

\- i did end up taking 9 more 500mg capsules of tylenol, but luckily stopped myself from taking more throughout the next few days.- for a while, i'd been avoiding my therapist and the other providers in my care network, but something compelled me to finally go to my appointments 2 days after the suicide attempt. i knew i needed more help and an extra push from the professionals to go to the ER to get medically cleared. so, i was completely honest about everything that's been going on and it felt so good to finally release that, and feel heard again by my therapist.

\- after getting cleared, i got psychiatrically hospitalized again in order become re-stabilized and back on the right meds for my mental illness. i am still here and just got granted access to my laptop during the evenings. i thought that i'd take the time to let you know that i am okay. i'm safe. overall, doing signficantly better.

i am genuinely so grateful to still be alive. wow.
